chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Abu al-Khazraj al-Hasan ibn al-Zibarqan al-Ansari, from al-Fadl ibn Uthman, from Abu Aziz al-Muradi, who said:
And he is the maternal uncle of my mother. He said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Take the cyperus (suda) for your teeth, for it aromatises the mouth and increases in copulation.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.السُّعْدَ: A salt-water plant (saltwort/cyperus) used for dental hygiene and freshening breath
key_terms.يُطَيِّبُ الْفَمَ: To make the mouth fragrant/freshen the breath

ai.seo_question: What are the dental and health benefits of using Suda according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) recommends using *suda* (saltwort or cyperus) for dental hygiene, highlighting its dual benefits of purifying the breath and enhancing sexual vitality. This reflects the Shia tradition of viewing prophetic medicine as a holistic practice that connects physical cleanliness with spiritual and marital well-being, emphasizing the importance of maintaining oral health as an act of worship and self-care.
